notes: Names: the street labelled only AVENUE running SW from West Liberty (6762,176) through Mayfield is recorded as Ross Avenue: it is collinear with the segment printed ROSS south of the E-W avenue (Ross ends at Warsaw). The long E-W street at y~1640 east of Quebec (12in sewer, 10in W pipe; printed only AVENUE, far east at x~8900) is '?' - possibly the continuation of Glenway Avenue, which is printed GLENWAY on the street running west from the Quebec/Warsaw junction at y~1778 (label at x~1200). The avenue running WSW from the Warsaw junction (6965,3470) is printed only AVENUE here; it continues west to the label ST. LAWRENCE at x~1200, y~4180, so recorded as St. Lawrence Avenue. The N-S AVENUE at x~5390 is printed SETON at its south end: Seton Avenue. RAPID and AVE. are printed on the street at x~5785 (recorded as Rapid Avenue; may be Rapid Run). AVE. at x~5888 south of St. Lawrence is printed KIRBERT at its south end. ENRIGHT printed at the south, AVE. at the north. Laclede, Carson and LaSalle are printed without suffix. Wessels: printed WESSELS on the south part and AVE. on the 40 ft north part (same alignment). The '?' street at (7120,1215) is a 40 ft street running east from Wessels to the N-S avenue at x~7342. The Quebec/Glenway/Warsaw/E-W avenue junction around (5450-5600,1700-1800) is a wide open plaza: Quebec meets the E-W avenue/Glenway line at (5562,1715); Warsaw's centreline meets Glenway at (5455,1775). Hamilton Avenue (x~5565) and Hazard (x~6130) at the bottom are printed (VACATED) and are not recorded. Not recorded (beyond x 7260): the N-S avenue at x~7342 (meets Mayfield, the y1215 street and the E-W avenue, then bends SW into Carson at ~7320,1950), and Sturm Street at x~7330. Spaced lettering (Glen Grove, G.F. Meyer's, Kuhlman's, Cynthia Terry's, Mann's, McCabes, Boyla's, Ross, Martin & ...) is subdivision names, not streets.
